verdict.rationale: Signifyd ships SDKs and a device-profiling script, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack, however, documents no opt-out for telemetry or usage tracking. Test teams keep orders out of model learning, but that is a test-isolation feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
